title: Friday Night Magic 2001: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Peace hath her victories No less renownd than war." —John Milton, "To the Lord General Cromwell"
"I will ... tell thee more than thou hast wit to ask." —Christopher Marlowe, *Doctor Faustus*
"Cry havoc and let slip the dogs of war." —William Shakespeare, *Julius Caesar*
"I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately." —Henry David Thoreau, *Walden*
"And in their blind and unattaining state their miserable lives have sunk so low that they must envy every other fate." —Dante, *Inferno*, trans. Ciardi
